# Rules for .slnx files

Each rule cites the code it rests on. A rule marked not yet reviewed is the estate's best reading, not a decision.

- [InformalDecision] The repository configures its solution using the modern XML-based Visual Studio solution format (.slnx) defining project hierarchies across `/src/`, `/src/Modules/`, and `/tests/`. [ClaimFlow.slnx:L1-L18]
